chunks: 2416 - And ʿAlī ibn Asbāṭ narrated from Abī al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام, who said: He said to me:

“When you leave your home, whether in travel or at home, then say: ‘In the Name of Allah, I believe in Allah, I rely upon Allah. Whatever Allah wills; there is no power and no strength except by Allah.’

Then the devils confront him, but the angels strike their faces and say: ‘What way do you have against him, when he has mentioned Allah, Mighty and Majestic, believed in Him, relied upon Allah, and said: Whatever Allah wills; there is no power and no strength except by Allah?’”

key_terms.آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ: A declaration of faith in Allah.
key_terms.الشَّيَاطِينُ: The devils who seek access to and harm against a person.
key_terms.الْمَلَائِكَةُ: The angels who defend and protect by Allah’s command.
key_terms.بِسْمِ اللَّهِ: Beginning in the Name of Allah as an act of remembrance and seeking blessing.
key_terms.تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ: I place my trust and reliance upon Allah.
key_terms.لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّه: There is no power or strength except through Allah.
key_terms.مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ: Whatever Allah wills comes to pass.

ai.seo_question: What supplication should be recited when leaving home for travel or daily matters?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a duʿa to be recited when leaving one’s home, whether for travel or otherwise. It emphasizes iman, tawakkul, and surrender to the divine decree, and describes this remembrance as a means of protection from the shayatin through the help of the angels.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.2416 - Ali ibn Asbat narrated from Imam Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (as), who said:
Imam (as) said to me: "When you leave your house, whether for travel or otherwise, say:
'In the name of Allah (swt), I believe in Allah (swt), I rely upon Allah (swt). Whatever Allah (swt) wills happens. There is no power and no strength except with Allah (swt).'
The devils will then confront you, but the angels will strike their faces and say:
'What path do you have over someone who has mentioned Allah (swt), believed in Him, relied upon Him, and said,
‘Whatever Allah (swt) wills happens. There is no power and no strength except with Allah (swt)?'"
